description: What Meta asks before it acts (a read outside its folders, a command, a change to this machine's models), at its conversation's end, and the answers.

messages.run: Meta would like to run this:
messages.run_why: Meta would like to run this ({$why}):
messages.search_web: Meta would like to search the web for “{$query}”
messages.grep: Meta would like to search in {$path}
messages.glob: Meta would like to look for files in {$path}
messages.remove_models: .input {$n :number} .match $n one {{Meta would like to remove {$n} model from Ollama: {$models}. They'd have to be downloaded again.}} * {{Meta would like to remove {$n} models from Ollama: {$models}. They'd have to be downloaded again.}}
messages.add_server: Meta would like to add {$name} at {$where} as a model server.
messages.add_server_key: Meta would like to add {$name} at {$where} as a model server, sending it the key in ${$variable}.
messages.copy_ollama: Meta would like to copy {$model} ({$size} GB) from {$host} into this machine's Ollama, over the mesh.
messages.copy_ollama_replacing: Meta would like to copy {$model} ({$size} GB) from {$host} into this machine's Ollama, over the mesh. It replaces the {$name} Ollama has here.
messages.copy_mlx: Meta would like to copy {$model} ({$size} GB) from {$host} into the Hugging Face cache here ({$hub}), over the mesh.
messages.build_apple: Meta would like to build apple-claude, which runs Apple's on-device model: swift build -c release, in apple-claude/ (a minute or two).
